items.name: Classic Country Sourdough
items.description: Our signature loaf — crispy crust, open crumb, tangy flavor. Made with a 72-hour cold ferment.

items.name: Whole Wheat Sourdough
items.description: Hearty and nutty with 50% fresh-milled whole wheat. Perfect for sandwiches.

items.name: Seeded Multigrain Sourdough
items.description: Packed with sunflower, flax, sesame, and pumpkin seeds. Crunchy outside, soft inside.

items.name: Rosemary Olive Oil Sourdough
items.description: Fragrant rosemary and extra-virgin olive oil folded into our classic dough.

items.name: Cranberry Walnut Sourdough
items.description: Tart cranberries and toasted walnuts in a lightly sweetened dough. A winter favorite.

items.name: Jalapeño Cheddar Sourdough
items.description: Texas heat meets tangy sourdough. Loaded with sharp cheddar and fresh jalapeños.

items.name: Cinnamon Raisin Sourdough
items.description: Swirled with Ceylon cinnamon and plump golden raisins. Amazing toasted.

items.name: Sourdough Focaccia (Half Sheet)
items.description: Crispy-bottomed, olive-oil-drenched focaccia topped with flaky salt and fresh herbs.

items.name: Sourdough Discard Crackers
items.description: Thin, crispy crackers made from sourdough discard. Perfect with cheese or hummus.

items.name: Sourdough Starter (Jar)
items.description: Take home a piece of our starter! Includes care instructions and a beginner recipe.
